name: mission-control
description: Turn a folder into a home-tab dashboard for tasks, projects, recurring work, bookmarks, and recent files.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: test -n "$VAULT_PLUGIN_DIR" && test -d "$VAULT_PLUGIN_DIR" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$VAULT_PLUGIN_DIR/"
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: andrewkfb
